_: The owner's pricing decisions (A: never lose money, the fee is max(bps, our gas + buffer + margin); B: the premium is priced from the pool holder's side, capital + ops while no arbitrator exists). Policy, not measurement: a calibration copies these into its fee block, and a chain may override one (chains.json policy).

buffer.regimeWhy: the scheduled check calls it a gas-regime change when the buffer moves by 500 bps or more, a leg's gas changes, or the prior moves (2 dp); smaller moves wait for the weekly run

history.why: 7 days: the p95 rise over 2 days swung from 1,874 to 8,921 bps within hours on Base (2026-10-01) because about 5 % of 65-minute windows hold a short spike; over 7 days it reads 1,678

provisionalLegsBufferWhy: a chain whose legs have no receipt of its own yet borrows another chain's (provisional): +25 % on that gas until its own rehearsal is re-read

x402.why: the x402 buyer leg (a hire paid to the seller by x402): our gas is 0 on exact (the seller's facilitator sends the EIP-3009 transfer), so the fee is max(bps, margin). With no settle line on the chain there is no hook: no evaluator fee, no hook cap, no cover pool
